scope: Isolated controller VM, generated SVG budgets and Node HTML generation timing. Not browser paint/FPS or device layout measurements.

checks.name: Viewport margin covers every hex intersecting the screen at all supported profiles
Drag within the guard buffer writes only the camera; a long pan updates the SVG scene without replacing HUD
Repeated wheel events coalesce into one animation frame and do not redraw the HUD
An active effect keeps its source scene alive during camera movement
Shared board clip avoids per-cell SVG definitions and every normal map unit uses one image
Overview uses native unit emblems and preserves every visible seat, HP and AP marker
Selecting a structure shows current HP in the corner; closing or clearing prevents persistent labels
A guarded building attack updates the corner during playback and the close button remains usable
Esc clears recent damage and a new game cannot inherit another observer’s health card
Resource buildings expose no structure card and fog only displays the cached HP
The 37 instrument illustrations are self-contained and eight active skill artworks differ
Continuous terrain has no internal boundary; coastline carries shallow gradient and ruins carry vines/crystals
Only core structures use armor decks/shield insignia; animation count is bounded and respects pause/reduced mode
Large map reduces generated SVG work relative to the published v1.1.3 scene
